supersedes.reason: add shared account context and deterministic target-position state transitions before model tournament

account_context.decision_time_unrealized_return_is_allow: current marked price versus historical entry price at DecisionTime; not a future reward label

model_action_api.reason: verbs are deterministic state transitions, not independently-accounted labels

derived_transition.reverse_atomic_semantics: CLOSE existing position with full exit cost, recompute account, then open opposite target with full entry cost only if all hard gates pass

position_accounting.add: increase fixed notional and update weighted average entry price by executed notional
position_accounting.trim: realize proportional PnL and funding on reduced notional; preserve entry price on remainder
position_accounting.close: realize all PnL/funding/cost and remove position
position_accounting.hold: keep fixed notional and entry; accrue signed funding and update MTM
position_accounting.reverse: close then conditionally open opposite; never net prices or costs across legs
position_accounting.pending: target transition executes only when delay matures; account continues MTM/funding before maturity
position_accounting.eof: discard unmatured pending; close open positions using frozen EOF rule for account reporting
position_accounting.withdrawal: apply effective g3-g5 withdrawal rules only after MTM/funding/exits and before new risk proposals

canonical_training_contexts.purpose: allow model code to train before chronological policy trajectories exist, without owner-specific account-state inventions
canonical_training_contexts.entry_price_rule: historical completed-bar open at decision_at - position_age_bars
canonical_training_contexts.unrealized_return_rule: decision_time current close versus canonical entry price with direction sign
canonical_training_contexts.cumulative_funding_rule: sum actual signed settlements between canonical entry and decision
canonical_training_contexts.cash_and_equity_rule: retained base before hypothetical position; mark position at decision; no synthetic withdrawal before decision
canonical_training_contexts.deterministic_hash_sampling: if full grid is too large, sample contexts by fixed event_id+context hash priority; sampling budget frozen before label generation

hashes.hash_method: Set hashes.overlay_hash to null, then compute repository datatruth.HashJSON.
